title: PATCH /api/users/me — update profile (name, avatar, email)
description: Update user's display name and/or avatar URL. Updating email requires re-verification (not in MVP — disallow email changes for now).
acceptanceCriteria: Email changes are NOT supported in MVP (return 400 if email included)

steps.details: updateProfileSchema = z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(255).optional(), avatarUrl: z.string().url().max(2000).optional() }). If body contains email, return 400 'Email changes not supported'. Update user. Return 200 with sanitized profile.
Update name — verify change. Update avatarUrl — verify change. Try updating email — expect 400.
